The rightmost chart, “TURNOVER,” shows industry at 33% (10.6 trillion), other services at 31% (9.8 trillion), trade at 31% (9.9 trillion), and construction at 6% (1.9 trillion). All segments are labeled with their respective percentage and absolute value, and the charts are arranged side by side with the largest segments visually positioned at the top left in each chart. The legend is present below the charts, and no segments are visually emphasized beyond their proportional size.
